title: Boundary extension criterion for a final vertex
statement: Use quasicategories and right-pinched mapping spaces as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $Q$ be a quasicategory and $t\in Q_0$. The spaces $\operatorname{Map}_Q(x,t)$ are contractible for every vertex $x$ if and only if, for every $m\geq1$ and simplicial map $\sigma:\partial\Delta^m\to Q$ whose last vertex is $t$, there exists an extension $\overline\sigma:\Delta^m\to Q$. Here $\partial\Delta^n$ denotes the union of the faces of $\Delta^n$, with $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$.

source.place: Proposition 4.7.3.11 (06R1), using Definition 4.7.3.1 of finality and the right-pinch comparison of Proposition 4.6.5.10 (01L5). This concerns a specified final vertex, not contractibility of the whole final-object subcategory.
